about: Reader's shared rules (reader.md): what a person's post is in Reader, its digest key, whether an item is read, and how two seen lists and two Reader lists merge. Times in seconds; days are UTC day numbers (created_at / 86400).

kindOf.name: a post with an imeta tag
a quote is not a reply (it's an item)
a nostr: link alone is not a link
a post with a Blossom picture (BUD-10)
a quote by q tag only

read.name: kept unread wins over read up to
kept unread, then read again (a negative time)
Mark all as read on Your people: the folder's read-up-to time
a Keep unread mark no newer than the source's read-up-to (marked all read after it) doesn't count
a Keep unread mark newer than the read-up-to wins
…and the folder's read-up-to counts the same

mergeSeen.name: days joined, read up to the larger, unread the newer, unknown fields kept
Keep unread on one device, read again later on another: read wins (and the other way round)
opened on another device before the mark reached it: the open's clearing (-t2) beats the older mark (t1)
another copy's read-up-to, written before this copy's Keep unread mark, doesn't pass the mark
…but one written after the mark (Mark all as read there, later) wins
the same from the other side (the mark in b, the read-up-to in a)

mergeReader.name: per source, folder and mute the newest wins; a removal is kept as gone

discussion.name: a Hacker News item from hnrss: the article, and its comments

item.description: Article URL: https://example.com/story Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=1 Points: 5

discussion.name: Lobsters: the guid is the discussion
an Ask HN: the link is the discussion itself, so no second link

fitSeen.name: old upto and unread go (30 days), recent stay; tombstones count by their size
over 48 KB (about 59 KB of keys): the oldest day goes, and it fits
over 48 KB with many read-up-to times: days go first (the newest stays), then the oldest read-up-to times, then cleared marks; Keep unread marks stay
cleared marks (negative) go after 7 days, Keep unread marks after 30

readUpTo.name: all read, the newest aged out: up to it
an older unread item that still shows: never to or past it
an unread item between: up to just before it
a Keep unread mark still standing caps it (even if its item didn't come in)
a day's posts count by their oldest unread post

stays.name: unread news, 20 days old: stays (30 days)
Keep unread doesn't keep it longer: news marked, 25 hours: gone
Keep unread, a digest at 1 day: stays (2 days)
Keep unread, a person's post at 3 days: gone
Keep unread, an article at 8 days: gone
starred, read, 40 days: stays (starred never ages out)
